subject.title: fix(msteams): preserve inbound activities before webhook ack

question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt this durable-before-ack delivery contract now, with its new persistence, replay, and retry behavior for eligible agent activities?
rationale: This is a high-impact channel-delivery boundary; source-only PR claims cannot determine whether the changed acknowledgement and retry semantics match the intended Microsoft Teams operational contract.

options.title: Require Teams lifecycle proof before merge
options.body: Confirm the upstream acknowledgement/retry contract and add redacted real Teams evidence for crash-after-ack restart replay, duplicate redelivery, and excluded non-agent workflows.

options.title: Accept the behavior change as reviewed risk
options.body: Merge after an owner explicitly accepts the new durable queue and replay semantics based on the existing focused test coverage.

options.title: Pause the adapter rollout
options.body: Keep the existing Teams delivery behavior until the channel-specific durability contract and operational proof are available.

recommendation.title: Require Teams lifecycle proof before merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the upstream acknowledgement/retry contract and add redacted real Teams evidence for crash-after-ack restart replay, duplicate redelivery, and excluded non-agent workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The available metadata shows this account authored the current durable-ingress implementation and its follow-up lifecycle corrections; current-main ownership history could not be independently traced.
